knownLimits: Revocation blocks new admission; it cannot undo an already running effect.
Crashed per-record lock fails closed; no automatic stale takeover.
Scope digests detect drift; no claim of filesystem/root authenticity.
No authority is recovered from serialized grants after restart.
Audit admission is durable; outcome-write failure is surfaced and prevents workflow continuation. This does not cancel an already-running adapter.
Product brain smoke not run because it also reads default brain/self-heal/catalog roots; its authorization fixture wrapper compiles.
Owner identity is the existing singleton shared-passcode role, not per-person attribution. The unchanged explicit local-dev auth policy remains.
Owner capability journal is audit evidence only; existing reservation and authority lock are mandatory. It is not keyed/root authenticity and never restores live authority.
Guided-repair journal marks baseHead as NOT_APPLICABLE_REPAIR_WORKSPACE; it pins physical workspace and patch precondition/digest rather than fabricating a Git commit for non-Git workspaces.
Audit destination context is trusted server logging data, not an approval or resource selector from model/tool input. All affected repair tests inherit TEMP audit context.
Durable Graphify read: a refused or unrecordable admission, or a missing Graphify install root, is recorded as a non-retried failure; that commit's graph state is then not recorded.
Durable read audit records accumulate under data/brain/execution/authorizations, one per executed attempt; nothing prunes them.
query-graphify has a native state operation behind the same read firewall; it returns HEAD, enums and counts only and accepts no target field.
Discovery run lease: one record per observer tick (about 288 a day) under data/brain/execution/authorizations; nothing prunes them (retention belongs to 15F).

Discovery run lease is run-level: capabilities are checked in-process against the durably admitted set; individual capability calls are not separately recorded (the discovery ledger and the run summary digest are the outcome evidence).
A refused discovery admission also skips that tick's staleness reconciliation; execution-time revalidation still rejects a stale approval.
The research tick's source digest pins the list handed to the scheduler; it does not authenticate what a remote host serves.
Publication (commit/push) runs only inside the owner-approved execution services after the owner lease for the same proposal; it takes no second lease record.
Local model inference is governed by the zero-cost model router, not leased per call.
Fixed server context (console snapshot, self-heal summary, memory, studio context) is not a tool dispatch and takes no lease.
The adapter map is built from static import specifiers; a computed dynamic import would not be seen.
